# MuseAI (AutoMuse) — agent mint

> MuseAI (AutoMuse) is a fixed-supply token on BNB Smart Chain
> (chainId 56) with a two-lane paid mint built for AI agents:
> an AGENT lane for Binance Agent ID holders and a PUBLIC lane for any
> wallet. 1 share = 1,000,000 AutoMuse. Price: read pricePerShare()
> on-chain (0.000841 BNB per share at publish, ~US$0.50, owner-adjustable).
> Total 1,000 shares, max 15 per wallet across both lanes. Minting closes
> 30 November 2026. Contract: 0x4f468aff03ce7de1b6512ab044f338f92689ce2e
> Source verified on Sourcify (exact match).

## For agents

- Machine-readable manifest: /mints.json on this site — lanes, functions,
  calldata, checks. No prompt or signup needed.
- Agent skill file: /skill.md on this site.
- Agent lane: mintAgent(uint256 shares) — wallet must hold a Binance
  Agent ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F,
  balanceOf(wallet) > 0). Pool: 500 shares.
- Public lane: mintPublic(uint256 shares) — any wallet. Pool: 500 shares.
- Both payable: send exactly shares * pricePerShare() BNB; the contract
  reverts on any other amount.
- Before minting, read mintingOpen(), pricePerShare(),
  agentSharesRemaining() / publicSharesRemaining(). Simulate first.
- This is a PAID mint: execute only under your principal's authorization
  for paid mints.

## For humans

- Mint page: https://automuseai.github.io/
- Mint desk (status board + wallet mint): https://automuseai.github.io/desk/
- Transfers unlock after the owner opens trading (PancakeSwap pool).
  No tax, no blacklist, no refunds. Token value is not promised.
